Namaste, I'm

Meet Pathak

Product learner by profession. Sport and arts lover by nature.

I build products for a living — currently Product Lead at Khatabook, earlier at Flipkart, CRED and Lendingkart, and co-founded Delighti. Trained in Mathematics & Computing at IIT Kanpur. Off the desk you'll find me on a badminton court or cricket ground, on a yoga mat, on a stage, on the road — or in a café corner, thinking about life.

Work

Now
Product Lead · Khatabook Building financial tools for millions of small businesses across India.
Earlier
Flipkart · CRED · Lendingkart · Delighti.com (Co-founder) From India's largest e-commerce shelves to fintech for the next billion — and one startup built from scratch. Every stop, a different masterclass in products, people and persistence.

The journey so far

  • Garoth, Madhya Pradesh

    Born in Indore, raised in Garoth — a small town where curiosity had a lot of open sky to grow in.

  • SKSGM, Bhanpura

    School years of dramatics, poetry, cricket, badminton and yoga — where I learnt to perform, to compete and to stay grounded.

  • IIT Kanpur

    Mathematics & Computing. Learned to think in structures and proofs — and to question everything else.

  • Product, since then

    Co-founded Delighti, then Flipkart → CRED → Lendingkart → Khatabook. Different companies, one thread: building things people actually use.

Beyond work

Sports

Badminton and cricket are lifelong loves — plus cycling trips and anything that gets a group outdoors and competing.

Performing arts

Dramatics since school days — the stage taught me presence. I still write the occasional poem when a thought demands it.

Yoga

A regular practice to slow down, stretch out and stay grounded — a habit that started in school and stuck.

Travel & road trips

Highways, lakesides, new cities. I travel to meet people from different cultures and professions — everyone has something to teach.

Cafés, books & big questions

My favourite third place: a quiet café, a good book, and time to think. I listen to spiritual teachers to understand life a little deeper — and write down some of it at Keen Attention, my blog.

Giving back

I care about people, and believe whatever we build should give something back to society.

Moments

If you'd like to talk products, sports, theatre, travel or the big questions — my inbox and DMs are open. The best conversations start with strangers.
